body_text: Introduction If you live in the United States and regularly send money to Nigeria, you know exactly what it costs, not just in dollars, but in time, stress, and value lost to hidden fees and poor exchange rates. According to the World Bank, the Sub-Saharan African diaspora sent home over $54 billion in 2023. But billions of that never reached families. It went straight to transfer fees, exchange rate markups, and intermediaries that had little reason to give you a better deal. There’s now a better option. Cleva is a fintech platform built by Africans, for Africans and it’s now available in the United States. With Cleva, you can send money from anywhere in the US directly to any naira bank account in Nigeria, with zero fees, competitive rates, and rewards on every transfer. And unlike most remittance platforms, Cleva doesn’t stop at money transfers. You can also buy data and pay electricity bills for your loved ones in Nigeria, all from the same app. Why it still costs too much to send money Traditional services like Western Union, MoneyGram, and bank SWIFT transfers were not built with the African diaspora in mind. Here’s what you’re dealing with: Transfer fees of $15–$30 per transaction Exchange rate markups that quietly reduce what your family actually receives Transfers that can take 1–3 business days, even for urgent needs No way to help with the smaller, recurring needs like data or electricity, so you’re stuck juggling separate apps just to fully support your family If you send $500 twice a month using traditional services, you could be losing $800–$900 a year to fees and markups alone. That’s money that could cover school fees, medical bills, or household expenses back home. What is Cleva? Cleva is a digital finance platform that has helped over a million Africans receive, save, and spend dollars seamlessly over the past two years. The platform is built around transparency, speed, and rewarding users, not penalising them for sending money home. With the US product now live, Nigerians in the diaspora can send money directly to any naira bank account in Nigeria, fund their wallets with a US debit card or stablecoins, and earn rewards in the process. And because supporting family back home is rarely just about a bank transfer, Cleva also lets you buy data and pay electricity bills for your loved ones directly from the app, something most remittance platforms simply don’t offer. How to send money from the US to Nigeria with Cleva Getting started takes just a few minutes: 1. Download the Cleva app , sign up and log into the app. 2. Verify your identity : Verify your identity by completing your KYC for security and compliance. 3. Add USD to your account Tap “Add funds” from the app homepage, then choose “From debit card” or “From stablecoins”, depending on how you’d like to fund your account. 4. Enter your funding amount After choosing your preferred method, input the amount you want to add to your account and tap “Add funds” to continue. Your wallet is funded instantly. 5. Start sending money Send to any naira bank account in Nigeria. Your recipient receives the money in minutes. Need to do more? Buy data or pay an electricity bill for them too, all from the same app. And that’s it. Why Nigerians in the US are choosing Cleva to send money home 1. Zero fees on debit card funding. Fund your Cleva wallet with your US debit card at no cost. If you prefer stablecoins, there’s a flat $1 fee for USDT or USDC deposits; no percentage-based charges and no hidden costs. 2. Favourable exchange rates. Cleva offers transparent and competitive rates. Your family, employees, friends etc receive the full value every time. 3. Fast, secure transfers. Transfers arrive in minutes, not days. Cleva is FDIC-insured in the US and uses end-to-end encryption on every transaction. 4. Earn Points on transfers and stablecoin deposits. Every time you send money to a naira account or deposit USDT/USDC, you earn Cleva Points, redeemable as real USD. 5. Provide real support for your family, beyond sending money Cleva goes beyond remittance. You can buy data and pay electricity bills for your loved ones in Nigeria directly from the app, so you’re not stuck switching between platforms just to take care of the people you love. 5. Enjoy $10 cashback (Limited-time offer) Send $200 or more, get $10 back instantly. This cashback offer is valid till the end of August 2026. Don’t miss it. 6. Save and earn with Cleva Pots. Not ready to send yet? Park your USD in Cleva Pots and earn interest while you wait. 7. Higher limits for larger transfers. Need to send a larger amount? Cleva supports higher transfer limits to accommodate bigger transactions. Frequently Asked Questions We know you have questions. Here are some answers to help you get started: 1. What is Cleva’s US transfer product? Answer: Cleva’s US transfer product lets people in the United States send money to any Naira account in Nigeria with zero fees, favourable rates, and fast delivery, all from one single platform. 2. Who can use Cleva’s US transfer feature, and how do I sign up? Answer: Anyone based in the United States with an SSN who wants to send money to Nigeria can use Cleva. Getting started is easy. Create your account here: https://getcleva.com/us 3. Which countries can I send money to from the USA? Answer: You can currently send money from the United States to Nigeria for now. More destination countries are coming soon… 4. How soon will my recipient receive the money? Answer: Recipients typically receive their money within minutes. 5. What are the fees for US transfers to Nigeria on Cleva? Answer: Transfers to Nigeria are free. Though stamp duty applies for amounts above 10,000 Naira. 6. Will I earn points on my transactions and how? Answer: Yes, you earn Cleva Points on two actions, and redeem them as real USD: You earn Points on every transfer to Nigeria. (must be greater than $10 to qualify) Funding your account with USDT or USDC earns points 7. Is there a limited-time offer for new users? Answer: Yes. Send $200 or more in a single transfer and get $10 back instantly. This is a limited-time offer, so don’t miss it. Check the app to see when the offer ends. 8. Can I save my USD on Cleva? Answer: Yes. With Cleva Pots, you can save your USD and earn rewards while you wait to send. It’s a great way to make your dollars work for you even when you’re not transferring. 9. Can I send money from the US to business accounts? Answer: Yes. You can send money from the United States to both personal and business accounts in Nigeria. 10. Why should I use Cleva instead of other platforms? Answer: Cleva is built to remove the stress from sending money home: Zero fees when you fund with your debit card Favourable exchange rates with no guesswork Fast, secure transfers Buy data and pay electricity bills for loved ones in Nigeria, something other platforms don’t offer Points earned on every transfer and stablecoin deposit, redeemable as real USD Cleva Pots to save and earn interest on your USD Higher limits available for larger transfers Conclusion Sending money home should not cost you a fortune, and supporting your family shouldn’t mean juggling five different apps. With Cleva, you get zero fees, competitive exchange rates, fast transfers, real rewards, and the ability to buy data and pay electricity bills for your loved ones, all in one place. Create your account in minutes at getcleva.com/us and make your first transfer today. Share this article

title: Benchmark Advanced Sensor Architecture Expertise Featured in Military + Aerospace Electronics
summary: Explore the future of defense sensing, from AI-enabled processing to multi-spectral integration, and how smarter sensors are shaping mission success.
body_text: Today's defense platforms face an increasingly complex operating environment. Autonomous systems, hypersonic weapons, electronic warfare, and coordinated multi-domain threats require more than faster hardware, they demand smarter sensing. The ability to detect, process, and act on information in real time has become a decisive advantage for modern defense systems. As a result, sensor technology is evolving beyond standalone electro-optical and infrared systems into intelligent, interconnected architectures capable of delivering actionable information when every second matters. These trends were recently explored in Military & Aerospace magazine's feature, "Sensor Technology: The Next Evolution in an Environment of Advancing Threat Capabilities," which included insights from Benchmark's Senior Director of Design Engineering, Keith Heinzig. His perspective highlights the growing importance of AI-enabled processing, multi-spectral sensing, and advanced system integration as the next generation of defense technologies takes shape. To learn more about the industry trends shaping the next generation of defense sensing, read Keith Heinzig's insights in the recent Military + Aerospace Electronics feature.

body_text: California Water Service Group Schedules 2026 Second-Quarter Earnings Results Announcement and Conference Call July 09, 2026 4:10 pm EDT Download as PDF SAN JOSE, Calif., July 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- California Water Service Group (NYSE: CWT) today announced that its 2026 second-quarter earnings results will be released at 9:00 a.m. ET with its earnings conference call to follow at 11:00 a.m. ET on Thursday, July 30, 2026. All stockholders and interested investors are invited to attend the conference call. To attend, please dial 1-800-715-9871 or 1-646-307-1963 and key in ID# 5478283, or you may access the live audio webcast at https://edge.media-server.com/mmc/p/p8cvrm58/ Please join at least 15 minutes in advance to ensure a timely connection to the call. A replay of the call will be available from 2:00 p.m. ET on Thursday, July 30, 2026, through September 28, 2026, at 1-800-770-2030 or 1-609-800-9909 and key in ID# 5478283, or by accessing the webcast above. The call will be hosted by Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer Martin A. Kropelnicki and Senior Vice President, Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer James P. Lynch. Prior to the call, Cal Water will furnish a slide presentation on its website. About California Water Service Group California Water Service Group is the parent company of regulated utilities California Water Service, Hawaii Water Service, New Mexico Water Service, Washington Water Service, and Texas Water Service, a utility holding company. Together, these companies provide regulated and non-regulated water and wastewater service to more than 2.2 million people in California, Hawaii, New Mexico, Texas, and Washington. California Water Service Group’s common stock trades on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol “CWT.” Additional information is available online at www.calwatergroup.com .
